prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1238; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a collision that occurred in a parking lot. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any other party has retained counsel, please provide us with that information as well.

We request that you disclose the full bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any umbrella or excess coverage, along with a copy of the declarations page for each policy. Please also confirm whether coverage has been accepted, denied, or is under reservation.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, surveillance or dash camera footage, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and all electronic records. Any destruction, alteration, or loss of such material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and your compliance with these requests.
